mapper.sql: sr.id, sr.user_id AS userId, sr.room_id AS roomId, sr.seat_id AS seatId, sr.reserve_date AS reserveDate, sr.status, sr.check_in_time AS checkInTime, sr.check_out_time AS checkOutTime, sr.overstay, sr.cancel_reason AS cancelReason, sr.create_time AS createTime, sr.update_time AS updateTime, u.real_name AS userName, u.student_no AS studentNo, u.college, r.name AS roomName, r.room_type AS roomType, s.seat_no AS seatNo
FROM seat_reservation sr LEFT JOIN sys_user u ON u.id = sr.user_id LEFT JOIN study_room r ON r.id = sr.room_id LEFT JOIN seat s ON s.id = sr.seat_id

where.if: AND (u.real_name LIKE CONCAT('%', #{query.keyword}, '%') OR u.student_no LIKE CONCAT('%', #{query.keyword}, '%') OR s.seat_no LIKE CONCAT('%', #{query.keyword}, '%') OR r.name LIKE CONCAT('%', #{query.keyword}, '%'))

mapper.select: SELECT d.dt AS `date`, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM seat_reservation sr WHERE sr.reserve_date = d.dt AND sr.status <> 'CANCELLED') AS reserved, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM seat_reservation sr WHERE sr.reserve_date = d.dt AND sr.check_in_time IS NOT NULL) AS checkedIn, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM seat_reservation sr WHERE sr.reserve_date = d.dt AND sr.check_out_time IS NOT NULL) AS checkedOut FROM ( SELECT DATE_SUB(#{endDate}, INTERVAL n DAY) AS dt FROM ( WITH RECURSIVE seq(n) AS (SELECT 0 UNION ALL SELECT n + 1 FROM seq WHERE n < 30) SELECT n FROM seq ) t ) d WHERE d.dt >= #{startDate} ORDER BY d.dt

SELECT r.id AS roomId, r.name AS roomName, r.room_type AS roomType, r.capacity AS capacity, IFNULL(SUM(CASE WHEN sr.status IN ('WAITING','SEATED') THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS reserved, IFNULL(SUM(CASE WHEN sr.status = 'SEATED' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS seated, IFNULL(SUM(CASE WHEN sr.status = 'LEFT' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS leftCount, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM long_term_seat lts WHERE lts.room_id = r.id AND lts.status = 'ACTIVE') AS longTermBinds FROM study_room r LEFT JOIN seat_reservation sr ON sr.room_id = r.id AND sr.reserve_date = #{date} GROUP BY r.id, r.name, r.room_type, r.capacity ORDER BY r.id

SELECT d.dt AS `date`, r.name AS roomName, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM seat_reservation sr WHERE sr.room_id = r.id AND sr.reserve_date = d.dt AND sr.check_in_time IS NOT NULL) AS checkedIn FROM ( SELECT DATE_SUB(#{endDate}, INTERVAL n DAY) AS dt FROM ( WITH RECURSIVE seq(n) AS (SELECT 0 UNION ALL SELECT n + 1 FROM seq WHERE n < 30) SELECT n FROM seq ) t ) d CROSS JOIN study_room r WHERE d.dt >= #{startDate} ORDER BY d.dt, r.id

SELECT h.hour AS hour, IFNULL(c.cnt, 0) AS cnt FROM ( WITH RECURSIVE hours(hour) AS (SELECT 0 UNION ALL SELECT hour + 1 FROM hours WHERE hour < 23) SELECT hour FROM hours ) h LEFT JOIN ( SELECT HOUR(check_in_time) AS hr, COUNT(*) AS cnt FROM seat_reservation WHERE reserve_date = #{date} AND check_in_time IS NOT NULL GROUP BY HOUR(check_in_time) ) c ON c.hr = h.hour ORDER BY h.hour

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN check_in_time IS NOT NULL THEN reserve_date END) AS checkInDays, COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN check_out_time IS NOT NULL THEN reserve_date END) AS checkOutDays, COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN check_in_time IS NOT NULL AND check_out_time IS NOT NULL THEN reserve_date END) AS bothDays, COUNT(DISTINCT reserve_date) AS recordDays FROM seat_reservation WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND reserve_date BETWEEN #{startDate} AND #{endDate}

SELECT DATE_FORMAT(reserve_date, '%Y-%m-%d') AS `date` FROM seat_reservation WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND reserve_date BETWEEN #{startDate} AND #{endDate} AND check_in_time IS NOT NULL GROUP BY reserve_date ORDER BY reserve_date

SELECT DATE_FORMAT(sr.reserve_date, '%Y-%m-%d') AS `date`, COUNT(*) AS reserved, SUM(CASE WHEN sr.check_in_time IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS checkedIn FROM seat_reservation sr WHERE sr.reserve_date BETWEEN #{startDate} AND #{endDate} AND sr.status <> 'CANCELLED' GROUP BY sr.reserve_date ORDER BY sr.reserve_date
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM seat_reservation WHERE reserve_date = #{date} AND check_in_time IS NOT NULL
